title: 🪄 Magic Monday with Fable! 🧙‍♂️
author: AntiqueFeedback7447
selftext:
Once again I'm quite impressed how a few, well defined prompts combined with learnings from previous projects can enable Fable to develop juicy, fun prototypes!

Done with @threejs, @claudeai Fable and some human input :)

replies.author: bettertagsweretaken
replies.body:
"juice" is anything that gives a game character and feedback. Screen shakes, particle effects, animations. Basically, the more your game does with each interaction from the player, the juicier it is. 

Search "juice it or lose it" on YouTube.

comments.author: brother_spirit
comments.body:
Cool. I'm guessing that's all procedural and Fable found a way to do that nice water colour style shading.   
I do like your mechanic for using the spell book. I'd love to see you take that in a "mostly non combat" direction. Obviously some enemies will need blasting but the real fun and depth is in the creative possibilities of spellcasting

comments.author: Time_Cat_5212
comments.body:
Wow!  The spell book is so vivid, so real.

And yet, all the spell amounts to is basic subtraction from a hit point pool?

It's amazing that with these tools in our hands we're still stuck on the basic arithmetic designed for pen and paper calculation with dice.
